findings: In components[1].sound and sound_limitation, include the cited Zhengzhang comparison: 爿 *zaŋ (also *braːn) beside 牀/床 *zraŋ, identified as a secondary report rather than independently verified phonetic evidence (X-70f78d947412ddb4c758, X-7ff6f30be3b3e6c2ef3f, X-c3f8fec59f373cb7b41f). The current sound array is empty despite this reported comparison, and the limitation says the Zhengzhang form is secondary. Update learner.components[1] to briefly explain that the reported forms are similar while retaining that evidentiary qualification.
